site.title: Alex Shorts
site.tagline: Designer, father, builder of things my family can actually use.
site.bio: Browser-first tools for scripture, learning, and family life. No installs — open a link and go.

projects.name: Alexander — Family tree
projects.desc: Interactive ancestry graph with portraits, vitals, and source documents.
projects.history: A shareable view of our FamilyTree research — people, parent links, photos, and catalogued records. Password-protected for family.

projects.name: Morganne — Family tree
projects.desc: Morganne's line from the same research engine — scoped for her side of the family.
projects.history: Same FamilyTree database, filtered to Morganne's blood and legal family. Family password required.

projects.name: Proverbs Link
projects.desc: Proverbs as a climb — Way of Life (10–31) above, firm foundation (1–9) below.
projects.history: Maps Proverbs onto a man's ascent through covering — from the fork between Life and Death to reign with Christ. Themes, Life|Death pairs, matrices, and full verse expansions for study at the table.

projects.name: Bible cross-reference rainbow
projects.desc: Zoomable arc map of scripture cross-references — follow links collection by collection.
projects.history: Cross-reference data rendered as colored arcs you can explore interactively — pan, zoom, and jump between connected passages.

projects.name: Element Campaign
projects.desc: Learn the elements with your kid — campaign, drills, duels, and offline play.
projects.history: A dad-and-kid periodic table trainer: progress through a campaign, drill symbols and names, duel each other, and keep going without Wi‑Fi.

projects.name: Bible worksheets
projects.desc: Weekly biblical imagery studies — student sheets, teacher guides, ready to print.
projects.history: Print-ready HTML worksheets for family study: verse, stories, coloring, and catechism — open in the browser and print to PDF.

projects.name: Biblical imagery library
projects.desc: Browse the imagery library by author, motif, and shelf — Spurgeon, Puritans, and more.
projects.history: Front door to the biblical imagery library: find authors, motifs, and shelf layouts before building a weekly study pack.
